eventListener.description: Event listeners attached to a component.

action.description:
The action to report when the event is triggered. If the event type is 'click',
defaults to clicked. Otherwise, this should be provided.
action.title: Action

eventType.description:
The type of event to listen for. Custom events, especially those with special
logic like keydownEnter, can be used if the Desktop code has been updated.
eventType.title: Event Type

target.description:
The component type to report when the event is triggered. Uses the child
component type (if exists), otherwise uses the parent component type.
target.title: Target

eventListener.title: Event Listener

eventListeners.description: An array of Event Listeners to apply to elements.
eventListeners.title: Event Listeners

method.description: The extraction method used for the query.

dataAttributeKey.description:
The data attribute key that will be looked up in order to retrieve its data
attribute value.

selectors.description: The query to inspect all elements on the SERP.

method.description: The extraction method to use for the query.

queryParamKey.description: The query parameter key to inspect in the href.

queryParamValueIsHref.description: Whether the query param value is expected to contain an href.

selectors.description: The query to use to inspect all elements on the SERP.

method.description: The extraction method to use for the query.

selectors.description: The query to use to inspect all elements on the SERP.

skipCount.description:
Whether to skip reporting of the count of these elements to ad_impressions.
Defaults to false.
skipCount.title: Skip Count

subframe.description: Ways to look for sponsored subframes

inspectRegexpInParent.description:
Whether the regexp should be used to inspect network events in the parent
process.

inspectRegexpInSERP.description: Whether the regexp should be used to inspect subframes in the content process.

regexp.description: A regular expression that matches subframes that hold sponsored content.

subframe.title: Subframe

accountCookies.description:
An array of cookie details that are used to determine whether a client is signed
in to a provider's account. NOTE: This property appears only in Firefox 127 but
was renamed to `signedInCookies` for Firefox 128 and beyond. Therefore do not
use this property. Please use `signedInCookies` instead.

host.description: The host associated with a given cookie.

name.description: The name associated with a given cookie.

accountCookies.title: Account Cookies

adServerAttributes.description: An array of strings that potentially match data-attribute keys of anchors.
adServerAttributes.title: Ad Server Attributes

alwaysMatchSERP.description:
If set, any URL matching searchPageRegexp is treated as a SERP without requiring
a query param in the specified process(es). Used for providers where the search
query is in the POST body rather than the URL.

child.description: Whether to skip the query param check in the child process.

parent.description: Whether to skip the query param check in the parent process.

alwaysMatchSERP.title: Always Match SERP

codeParamName.description: The name of the query parameter for the partner code.
codeParamName.title: Partner Code Parameter Name

components.description: An array of components that could be on the SERP.

default.description:
Whether this component should be the fallback option if a link was included in
both ad-related regular expressions as well as regular expressions matching
non-ad elements but couldn't be categorized. Defaults to false.

excluded.description: Conditions that should not be included.

selector.description:
The root DOM element that shouldn't be a parent from the context of the anchor
being inspected.

children.description: Child DOM elements of the parent. Optional.

countChildren.description:
Whether we should count all instances of the child element instead of anchor
links found inside of the parent. Defaults to false.

selector.description: The selector to use querySelectorAll from the context of the parent.

type.description: The component type to use if this child is present.

children.title: Children

parent.description:
The DOM element that should only contain elements applicable to a single
component type.

selector.description:
If topDown is true for this component, then this will be the value used in
querySelectorAll(). Otherwise, it will be the value to in closest() from the
context of an anchor.

parent.title: Parent

selector.description:
The selector to use querySelectorAll from the context of the parent. Any
elements specified will have their click events registered and categorized as
expanded unless explicitly overwritten in SearchSERPTelemetryChild.

topDown.description:
Whether the component should be found first by using document.querySelectorAll
on the parent selector definition. Defaults to false.

type.description: The type of component the anchor or DOM element should belong to.

components.title: Components

key.description:
The key corresponding to the query parameter that contains what type of search
page is being shown.

value.description: The value corresponding to the query parameter that should be matched against.

domainExtraction.description: An array of methods for extracting domains from a SERP result.

ads.description: An array of methods for extracting domains from ads.

nonAds.description: An array of methods for extracting domains from non-ads.

domainExtraction.title: Domain Extraction

expectedOrganicCodes.description:
An array of partner codes to match against the parameters in the url. Matching
these codes will report the SERP as organic:none which means the user has done a
search through the search engine's website rather than through SAP.
expectedOrganicCodes.title: Expected Organic Codes

extraAdServersRegexps.description: An array of regular expressions that match URLs of potential ad servers.
extraAdServersRegexps.title: Extra Ad Server Regular Expressions

filter_expression.description:
A JEXL to filter records. See
https://remote-settings.readthedocs.io/en/latest/target-filters.html#how
filter_expression.title: Filter Expression

followOnCookies.description: An array of cookie details that are used to identify follow-on searches.

codeParamName.description: The name of parameter within the cookie.

extraCodeParamName.description:
The query parameter name in the URL that indicates this might be a follow-on
search.

extraCodePrefixes.description:
Possible values for the query parameter in the URL that indicates this might be
a follow-on search.

host.description: The hostname on which the cookie is stored.

name.description: The name of the cookie to check.

followOnCookies.title: Follow-on Cookies

followOnParamNames.description: An array of query parameter names that are used when a follow-on search occurs.
followOnParamNames.title: Follow-on Search Parameter Names

ignoreLinkRegexps.description:
Regular expressions matching links that should be ignored by the network
observer.
ignoreLinkRegexps.title: Ignore links matching regular expressions

impressionAttributes.description:
An array of attributes to check and record for SERP impressions. Only supported
in Firefox 149 onwards.

attributeName.description:
The attribute name to inspect on the selected elements. If not provided, the
presence of the element is used.

countImpressions.description: Whether to count impressions for this component when the element is found.

type.description: The type of component the element belongs to.

regexp.description: A regular expression to match against the attribute's value.

selector.description: The CSS selector to use querySelectorAll from the context of the SERP.

key.description: The identifier for this impression attribute.

regexp.description: A regular expression to match against the page URL.

value.description:
A value to set for the attribute automatically. Useful if the attribute isn't
available for the provider.

impressionAttributes.title: Impression Attributes

isSPA.description:
Whether the provider exhibits tendencies of a single page app, namely changes
the entire contents of the page without having to reload.
isSPA.title: Is Single Page App

nonAdsLinkQueryParamNames.description:
Query param names present in non-ads link that recover the link that will be
redirected to.

items.string: The query param name to examine.

nonAdsLinkQueryParamNames.title: Non-ads link query param names

nonAdsLinkRegexps.description:
An array containing known patterns that match non-ad links from a search
provider.
nonAdsLinkRegexps.title: Non-ads link matching regular expressions

organicCodes.description:
An array of partner codes to match against the parameters in the url. Matching
these codes will report the SERP as organic:<partner code>, which means the
search was performed organically rather than through a SAP.
organicCodes.title: Organic Codes

enableSPAHandling.description: Whether a given SERP should be processed using the logic for single-page apps.

keys.description:
An array of strings representing the key(s) corresponding to the query
parameter(s) that contains what type of search page is being shown.

enabled.description: Whether we should track this page type.

isDefault.description:
Whether this page type represents a default SERP. We fall back to this property
in case, upon a page load, there is a delay in adding the page type param to the
URL.

name.description: The name of the page type.

target.description: The target to be recorded in telemetry.

values.description: An array of strings representing the possible page types.

queryParamName.description:
The name of the query parameter for the user's search string. This is
deprecated, in preference to queryParamNames, but still defined for older
clients (pre Firefox 121).
queryParamName.title: Search Query Parameter Name

queryParamNames.description: An array of query parameters that may be used for the user's search string.
queryParamNames.title: Search Query Parameter Names

searchMode.description:
A map of param names to search modes, e.g. image_search. Default if not
specified is 'normal_search'.
searchMode.title: Search Mode Param Mapping

searchPageMatches.description: An array containing match expressions used to match on URLs.
searchPageMatches.title: Search Page Matches

searchPageRegexp.description: A regular expression which matches the search page of the provider.
searchPageRegexp.title: Search Page Regular Expression

inspectRegexpInSERP.description: Whether the regexp should be used against hrefs the selector matches against.

regexp.description:
The regular expression to match against a possible shopping tab. Must be
provided if using this feature.

selector.description:
The elements on the page to inspect for the shopping tab. Should be anchor
elements.

signedInCookies.description:
An array of cookie details that are used to determine whether a client is signed
in to a provider's account.

host.description: The host associated with a given cookie.

name.description: The name associated with a given cookie.

signedInCookies.title: Signed-in Cookies

subframes.description: An array of methods for determining if a sponsored subframe exists.
subframes.title: Subframes

taggedCodes.description:
An array of partner codes to match against the parameters in the url. Matching
these codes will report the SERP as tagged.
taggedCodes.title: Partner Codes

telemetryId.description: The telemetry identifier for the provider.
telemetryId.title: Telemetry Id
